g.name: Mohamed Elmohamdy
g.line: Creativity meets data to build content that delivers measurable business results.
g.about: I’m a Social Media Strategist specializing in organic growth, combining creativity with data-driven insights to build impactful content and deliver measurable business results.

p.b: Saudi brand for premium oud and saffron, curated perfumes and gift packages, focused on luxury and an exceptional customer experience.
ch: Very low engagement and content views
Client needed sales through organic social
Client requested more followers
st: Promoted best-selling store products with client-approved discounts
Periodic offers and contests with clear rules (follow the page, share the post)

p.b: Saudi brand offering water desalination systems, filters, ice makers and tanks, plus maintenance services and warranties.
ch: Very low views on social media
Goal: outperform the main competitor in views
Grow followers and sales organically
st: Motion reels explaining common filter issues and why each filter stage matters
Waz and Waza animated characters teaching kids daily tips, reaching parents indirectly

p.b: Saudi specialty coffee brand with fine beans and coffee essentials for home brewing and cafes.
ch: Unorganized layout and appearance
Store customers weren’t following social accounts
Little to no engagement
st: Products shown in creative lifestyle formats
Contests with follow, like and branded hashtag rules
Saudi National Day and Ramadan videos

p.b: Modern fast-food restaurant and café in Mansoura. I worked as Social Media Specialist and Content Creator with a friendly Egyptian tone of voice.
ch: Launch a new menu with packaging inspired by a well-known competitor, and make it spark curiosity
st: Created the concept, design and motion: a blurred image gradually revealing the new packaging
Reveal concept lifted engagement and increased orders at the branch

p.b: Saudi brand for men’s traditional clothing (mishals, ashmagh and more) with branches across Saudi Arabia, known for quality materials and competitive pricing.
ch: Nearly 1M annual visitors across branches, yet under 4K followers on all platforms
On-ground campaigns to convert visitors into followers had failed
st: Launched new collections on social before the website and stores to create exclusivity
Follower-only promotions
Contests requiring a follow to enter
Consistent presence to lift visibility and engagement

p.b: Reputable Riyadh-based dealership with a wide range of vehicles, warranties and flexible installment plans with all Saudi banks.
ch: Very low views
Followers in continuous decline
Unorganized content layout
st: Reorganized the account and showcased cars in new formats
Monthly motion videos on cars displayed in exhibitions
Video scripts, shooting ideas and UGC requests

p.b: Saudi digital marketing agency helping businesses simplify marketing and achieve measurable growth. Audience: SMBs, e-commerce, startups, personal brands.
ch: Limited audience growth and awareness
Low engagement; views not converting to followers or leads
High competition and a need for trust and differentiation
st: Awareness: short-form video, educational content, consistent publishing
Trust & engagement: case studies, success stories, interactive formats
Lead generation: conversion-focused content, clear CTAs, website journeys

p.b: Saudi digital marketing agency positioned as a strategic growth partner, not just an execution agency. Storytelling-driven, human, insightful.
ch: Limited brand awareness and digital presence
Reach not converting into engagement
Limited social proof and case studies
st: Awareness through real business situations and insights
Trust through educational storytelling and social proof
Leads through CTAs, website journeys and service offers

p.b: Egyptian digital marketing company in Mansoura. I worked in-house as Social Media Strategist & Content Creator.
ch: Turn Egypt’s World Cup moment into brand engagement
st: Content ideas and interactive questions inviting audience opinions
Internal employee competition to build team participation
Connected a trending sports moment to the brand externally and internally
